newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: CS Holding sees higher op result.
newsitem.headline: CS Holding sees higher op result.

text.p: CS Holding said on Monday it expected a higher operating result for the full year 1996 but cautioned that provisions for credit risk would remain high due to a weak Swiss economy.
CS Holding said its net result for the full year would depend on the level of provisions.

"We expect our operating result for 1996 to be higher than last year; however, business performance in the final quarter will depend to some extent on the state of the financial markets and the net result will depend upon provisions for credit risk which will remain at a high level," it said in a statement on nine-month results.
The group, whose flagship bank is Credit Suisse, provided no specific figures.
In 1995, CS Holding posted a five percent rise in net profit to 1.40 billion Swiss francs.

CS Holding said its reorganisation, announced in July, was proceding as planned and the new organisational and management structure would take effect with its name change to Credit Suisse Group on January 1.
